stories.title: Freeman Johnson, oldest survivor of Pearl Harbor attack, dies aged 106
stories.summary: Johnson was working on the USS St Louis and was inside a steam drum when the attacks took place The oldest known survivor of the Pearl Harbor attack died Saturday aged 106 years old. Freeman Johnson, a fireman below the deck during the attack, died in his home in Massachusetts, according to the Boston Globe . Only 11 known Pearl Harbor survivors are still living, all of whom are centenarians. Continue reading...

stories.title: California braces for more towering waves as powerful storms approach
stories.summary: NWS issues advisories for long stretches of the northern California coast, warning that waves can quickly overpower anyone nearby The massive, 50-foot swells along California’s coast this weekend foretold an intense week of towering waves to come. Officials from the National Weather Service (NWS) had issued advisories for long stretches of the California coast, warning people that erratic and unpredictable waves could quickly overpower anyone nearby. The highest waves – which reached 50 to 60ft (15.24 to 18.29 meters) – cracked along the popular Mavericks surf spot in San Mateo county, south of San Francisco. Continue reading...
